g.text: Repeated schedule prompt in the same session · default tier
Hollow circle: fresh; filled diamond: warm. Teal: Nanocodex; orange: OpenAI Agents. Medians across low/high efforts and repetitions.
Warm repeats include conversation context and provider cache effects, so this does not isolate connection reuse.
